Along the way, you have likely found yourself writing scripts or building tools to eliminate repetitive work, improve consistency, and catch problems earlier. In this role you will own the Altium component library, develop automation, and then build and integrate scripted and AI-assisted tools across our electrical design and analysis workflows for years to come. You’ll bring hands-on embedded Linux experience and an active interest in networking. Maybe you’ve implemented or debugged a routing protocol, contributed to a networking stack, or built a home lab to experiment with routing and trace where packets get dropped. Experience with routing software or programmable packet processing is a plus, and we welcome experience across networking stacks.

You will be responsible for the design and implementation of FPGA code either with a focus on DSP algorithms to modulate and demodulate signals on board our software defined radio (SDR), or embedded systems interfacing with processors and peripherals. To be effective you will need to participate in all phases of FPGA design flow (Simulation, Synthesis, Place & Route, Timing Closure and Hardware Testing). A good understanding of the intricacies of FPGA development would make a candidate standout.

You will translate program objectives into executable technical plans, aligning requirements, architecture, interfaces, trade studies, verification evidence, and risk decisions across a large cross-functional team. The ideal candidate has demonstrated experience delivering through at least one satellite-level program lifecycle. Experience with constellation-level architectures, multi-satellite delivery, or cross-program technical execution is a strong asset. This role requires strong systems engineering judgment, the ability to lead through ambiguity, and the communication discipline to align teams and stakeholders while balancing technical integrity with cost, schedule, risk, mission assurance, and customer expectations. This position is intended for a technical leader who can operate with credibility across engineering, program management, product assurance, suppliers, customers, and senior leadership. T1/T2 expectations emphasize ownership of technical outcomes, disciplined integration, requirements alignment, decision closure, readiness evidence, and system-wide integration readiness across multiple subsystems.

You will work closely with cross-functional engineering teams, including RF, mechanical, software, FPGA and systems engineering, to develop and integrate hardware solutions for current and future satellite platforms and customer missions.

The successful engineer understands the full signal chain, from photons to bits, and can engage the engineers and suppliers responsible for each key element of the payload. The role focuses on VNIR as well as cooled and uncooled infrared payloads that balance mission performance and product requirements against cost, schedule, and SWaP, and collaborates across Sales & Product, Satellite Systems Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering & Perception, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Test Engineering.

jobs.title: 3D Computer Vision Researcher – Arlington, VA
jobs.description_text: Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications. In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. Kitware partners with government R&D agencies, branches of the U.S. military, members of the Intelligence Community, and commercial organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. You’ll have opportunities to collaborate directly with customers, participate in field tests and demonstrations, publish novel work, and apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to real-world national security challenges.

Intropic forecasts index rebalances and the passive fund flows they trigger, for hedge funds, banks and asset managers. You'll read each index methodology, implement it in code, validate it against real index outcomes, run it through live review periods, and explain to clients why it forecasts what it does. You'll also build the products clients use on top of those forecasts. Who we're looking for Someone with a strong quantitative foundation that they apply, and real forecasting judgement. You understand what a model's output means in probability terms, which assumptions it rests on and where it breaks. You write fluent Python and SQL, turn messy real-world rules into precise code, and are curious about what drives financial markets.

Our APAC client base of quantitative funds, trading firms and sell-side institutions across Hong Kong, Japan and Singapore has grown to the point where it needs specialist support during its own market hours rather than from London. This leader will own the technical strategy and execution required to transform mission objectives into reliable, flight-ready systems. The role combines deep technical leadership with team building and cross-functional execution, spanning algorithms, modeling and simulation, embedded software, perception, autonomy, and vehicle-level integration. jobs.description_text: Internal Ballistician DESCRIPTION Long Wall is seeking an experienced Ballistician to support the design, development, testing, and production of solid rocket motors (SRMs) for our interceptor system. This role is responsible for ensuring that SRM ballistic performance meets demanding missile-interception requirements while remaining manufacturable at scale. The Ballistician serves as the technical authority for SRM internal ballistics and overall booster performance. Responsibilities include developing and optimizing propellant grain designs; performing SRM performance analysis (including sensitivity to off-nominal conditions); reviewing and interpreting static-fire and flight-test data; providing technical oversight and direction to propulsion suppliers; and defining ballistic requirements and verifying compliance throughout development and production. The successful candidate will establish rigorous analytical methods while driving efficient program execution. They will work closely with propulsion, structures, aerodynamics, guidance and control, manufacturing, and systems engineering teams to ensure ballistic decisions remain aligned with system-level performance, technical baselines, and program objectives The compensation range for this role is $120,000 - $200,000/yr This is the lowest to highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

Au cœur de l’équipe, tu coordonnes les différentes expertises afin d’assurer l’alignement, une communication fluide et l’atteinte des objectifs. jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description_text: Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing! Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more. Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them. Why This Matters We don’t just build robots—we’re building the essential infrastructure for next generation biologics. Our technology enables biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, reducing regulatory hurdles and lowering costs so these treatments can reach more patients. The Stack & The Scale The Mission: Build the world’s best robots to make life-saving therapies accessible to all. The Technology: Advanced robotic orchestration, high-precision automation, cloud-integrated hardware-software systems, dextrous manipulation, and imitation learning. The Location: Headquartered in San Francisco, CA. The Backin

In this role, you will deliver instructor-led training designed to introduce participants to foundational AI concepts, generative AI applications, and practical techniques for integrating AI into everyday workflows. Your work will help personnel to develop the knowledge, confidence, and skills necessary to effectively and responsibly use approved AI-enabled tools. The ideal candidate will have experience in technical instruction, adult education, military training, and/or workforce development along with hands-on experience using generative AI applications. This role requires collaboration with technical personnel, training coordinators, functional subject matter experts (SMEs), and government stakeholders to deliver effective instruction and support continuous improvement of training materials

As an Account Executive on our Commercial team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll manage a high volume of opportunities, work with one or a small group of decision-makers (often a hands-on engineering leader or CTO), and move deals efficiently from the first conversation to close. You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to create a seamless customer experience. jobs.title: Analyst, Royalty Operations
jobs.description_text: Royalty Operations owns the operations behind Spotify’s royalty process across music, audiobooks, lyrics, and creator content. We implement content licenses in Spotify’s proprietary royalty systems, calculate and report royalties to our rightsholder partners, provide analytics to Accounting stakeholders, and serve as the go-to team for royalty questions across the company. As our business grows more complex, we’re focused on staying accurate and on time while getting faster and more flexible through scripting, Gen AI, and agentic workflows.

As an Artist & Label Partnerships Manager your mission is to ensure that key artists, managers, and labels see Spotify as the #1 partner for artist development and monetization. In this role you will work with a set of core label partners and artists. This role has a strong focus on launching innovative partnerships and initiatives and you will drive activations that enable, educate, and unlock new opportunities for our partners and Spotify. We seek a highly motivated partner manager based in Berlin with a strong partnerships, music marketing and music / entertainment / media background. This individual must be able to prioritize, multi-task, and influence in a fast paced environment. This role is on a 15-month fixed-term contract.

jobs.title: Associate Artist Label Partnerships Manager, South Korea
jobs.description_text: Spotify’s Artist & Label Partnerships (ALP) team works with artists, managers, record labels and distributors to help artists grow their audiences and connect with fans. As an Associate Artist & Label Partnerships Manager on the Korea Music team, you’ll manage relationships with selected partners and lead campaigns that help Korean artists reach more listeners at home and around the world. You’ll work with artist and label teams to understand their goals and turn them into opportunities for fans to discover and engage with their music.

jobs.title: Audiobook Licensing & Partnerships Manager - Japan

You’ll help build our publisher portfolio and secure a catalogue that resonates with listeners in Japan. After launch, you’ll keep owning and growing these partnerships so they deliver lasting value for Spotify and our publishing partners.

Our services manage the lifecycle of every Spotify subscription, including activation, renewals, plan changes, grace periods, and cancellations. You'll help build and improve the backend services and data systems that millions of subscribers depend on. Whether you're growing your engineering experience or looking for a new technical challenge, you'll have opportunities to learn, collaborate, and make a meaningful impact on Spotify's subscription experience.

jobs.title: Client Partner - Emerging & Scaled (French Speaking)
jobs.description_text: Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. We are looking for an exceptional Client Partner to join our Emerging & Scaled team, one of the fastest-growing units within Spotify’s Ad Sales organization. This role is perfect for someone who wakes up every morning excited to connect with clients and inspire them with the power of Spotify. You bring curiosity, resilience, and a collaborative mindset, along with a passion for building meaningful client partnerships. Integrity and a healthy work-life balance are non-negotiable. You’ll shape how Spotify advertisers reach audiences and elevate their connection to our platform.

jobs.title: Client Partner ANZ
jobs.description_text: Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. You will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across sales, marketing, and product teams to deliver innovative advertising solutions that meet the needs of our clients while maximising revenue opportunities for Spotify. Please note this is a fixed-term, 12 months, contractor role hired through a third party.

jobs.title: Data Scientist  - Business Analytics
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Data Scientist to join the Business Analytics team within Spotify’s Business Strategy and Insights organization. Our team tackles some of Spotify’s most consequential strategic questions, shaping the trajectory of our business and improving the experiences of our over 700M active users across more than 180 countries. In this role, you will use data analysis, experimentation, and statistical modeling to identify, assess, and launch a broad range of new initiatives and product features focused on payments and payments fraud. You will also regularly assess the health of our business and identify areas of opportunity, translating these insights into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership. At Spotify, you'll have access to some of the richest datasets in the world and the autonomy to explore them creatively and rigorously. Above all, your work will shape how the world listens, discovers, and connects through audio.

jobs.title: Demand Generation & Campaign Operations Manager
jobs.description_text: The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers. You run our websites, search, webinars and email across the Spotify Technology portfolio. Your job is to bring people into the funnel and move them through it: from finding us in search or at a webinar, to signing up, to becoming an active user, to a meeting with sales. You also own the numbers. Every week you tell the team what’s working, what isn’t and what we’re changing. You work AI-first, you know our martech stack inside out, and you use the newest features of both.

As our Pop Editor, you’ll bring deep cultural expertise and a data-informed approach to shape how millions of people discover music across playlists, video, and other parts of the app.

Working across marketing, product, data and commercial teams, you'll shape our growth strategy, turn customer insights into action and find new ways to connect Japanese listeners with Spotify Premium. You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while developing your leadership responsibilities over time.

We build scalable machine learning solutions that personalize the subscriber journey, from conversion through to long-term retention. Working closely with teams across the mission, we develop ML solutions that improve key business metrics, including subscriber growth, monthly active users, and Premium retention. We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Radius squad. You'll take ownership of impactful ML initiatives, develop and improve production models, and contribute to the foundational ML capabilities that power personalization and optimization across Subscriptions. Your work could include reducing friction for Free users while balancing retention and conversion, improving payment experiences to reduce Premium churn, or developing reusable models such as subscriber embeddings that support multiple products and use cases.

That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to help shape Spotify's TV and Desktop experiences. These surfaces give people different ways to enjoy Spotify, from music and video in the living room to the experience that accompanies them throughout their day on a computer. As a senior individual contributor, you'll work across both areas, bringing a strong product perspective to the opportunities that matter most. You'll help teams make ambitious choices, navigate complexity, and deliver experiences that people love.

As Revenue Operations Manager, you'll own revenue operations for Spotify Technology, helping our sales organization scale from early growth to a mature, segmented go-to-market model. This is a hands-on role where you'll work closely with the business day to day, identify challenges early, and build the systems, processes, and insights that enable sustainable growth. You'll partner with Sales leadership, Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success to improve how we operate across the customer lifecycle. You'll balance strategic planning with practical execution, creating structure that helps our teams work efficiently as the business evolves.

jobs.title: Security Engineer - Product Security
jobs.description_text: The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers. Security engineers at Spotify help protect our environment and more than 700 million users. Within Platform, our Product Security team evaluates and communicates Spotify's security posture, helping developers and leadership make informed decisions about security risks. We own the vulnerability management platform, supporting the full lifecycle of identifying, attributing, remediating, and reporting security vulnerabilities. As AI changes how vulnerabilities are discovered and exploited, we're evolving how Spotify responds. We're looking for a Security Engineer to help transform vulnerability findings into reliable, actionable code improvements using agentic AI. You'll build the tools, workflows, and evaluation frameworks that make automated remediation more effective, scalable, and safe, while helping developers focus on building great experiences for our users.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant, General Ledger Accounting
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Senior Accountant to join our Global Record to Report (RTR) team. Our close is evolving fast, and we’re looking for someone who combines strong accounting judgment with curiosity about how AI and automation can change how we work, and who wants to help build that future rather than wait for it. As a Senior Accountant on the General Ledger team, you will own key close processes end to end, from preparation and analysis to explaining results to partners across Finance. You will use data and AI tools to remove manual work, spend more of your time on review and insight, and help shape how a lean, global team scales.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Content Platform
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We own music content ingestion at Spotify, which is how music from labels, distributors and other partners gets onto the platform. We receive industry-standard deliveries, validate them, and turn them into the catalog data that teams across Spotify build on, including lyrics, rights and supply data. As we add new content types and partners, we’re building an ingestion platform that scales without a custom build every time.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Subscriptions
jobs.description_text: The Subscriptions Mission builds and scales the products, platforms, and business models that turn free listeners into lifelong Premium subscribers. We focus on attracting new subscribers, improving conversion and retention, and creating seamless commerce experiences that support Spotify's growth and bring fans closer to the creators they love. At Spotify, subscription data helps shape the decisions and experiences behind our 700M+ monthly active users and 290M+ Premium subscribers. You'll join a collaborative team building the backend systems that power merchandising, personalized experiences, and subscription journeys at a global scale. Your work will help listeners discover the value of Premium and give them more reasons to stay.

jobs.description_text: Hundreds of millions of people come to Spotify to listen for free. Our ambition is to make that experience great while helping listeners discover the value of Premium. Getting that balance right is one of the most important opportunities for Spotify's continued growth. The Freemium Funnel team shapes the journey from Free listening to Premium subscription and beyond. We bring together Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Research, and Marketing to understand what listeners value, remove barriers to conversion, and create experiences that make Premium a compelling choice. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Free and Conversion Surfaces team. You'll shape how listeners engage with Spotify Free, discover Premium, make the decision to subscribe, and experience their first moments as paying subscribers. From Premium education to conversion experiences and early retention, you'll work on meaningful product challenges that directly influence Spotify's growth. This is an opportunity to think strategically, build at scale, and turn complex challenges into simple, engaging experiences that work for both our listeners and our business.

We focus on helping listeners discover, experience, and unlock the full value of Spotify through awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to help shape the future of Spotify's Freemium experience. You'll lead product initiatives that make Premium more compelling, improve the journey from Free to Paid, and create experiences that reflect the needs of local audiences. Working closely with engineering, design, data science, research, marketing, and regional teams, you'll turn consumer insights into meaningful product experiences that drive sustainable subscriber growth.

These solutions help employees confidently adopt and apply Sales Operations systems, capabilities, and business processes, improving adoption, knowledge retention, and performance. The ideal candidate brings 3-5 years of relevant experience, strong instructional design and content-development capabilities, and the ability to independently own work from concept through delivery. AI, automation, and emerging technologies are expected to be integral to how the role develops content, improves workflows, and increases operational efficiency.

jobs.title: Scrum Master

jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Senior Scrum Master provides Agile delivery leadership for the System Architecture and Dev Solution Integration teams. The role applies Kanban to architecture work and Scrum/SAFe practices to integration delivery, while partnering closely with the RTE to maintain PI readiness, cross-team alignment and predictable execution. Role focus: Strengthen architecture flow and solution integration delivery through pragmatic Agile practices, active dependency management and close alignment with the RTE and PI cadence.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive, Mexico & Central America
jobs.description_text: Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years. Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators. Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world. The company’s state-of-the-art Satellite fleet consists of 12 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat-1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite. For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com

jobs.title: Senior Defence Systems Engineering Specialist
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com Are you passionate about breakthrough technologies and eager to shape the future of satellite-based solutions for defence and national security? We are seeking a Senior Defence Systems Engineering Specialist to help shape new satellite-enabled capabilities for Canadian and allied defence users. Reporting to the Director, Research & Development, Defence Satellite Mission Solutions, you will lead multidisciplinary investigations from mission-need qualification through initial prototype laboratory validation. Initial opportunities include system features such as alternative positioning, navigation and timing (PNT), optical relay connectivity with other satellite systems, and space-domain awareness data products. You will combine technical depth with systems thinking, practical experimentation and multidisciplinary leadership.

jobs.title: Senior DevSecOps Developer
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We are seeking a Senior DevSecOps Developer to help build and operate secure embedded and cloud-native software delivery environments. This role will provide technical leadership for the implementation and integration of security capabilities within CI/CD pipelines, including static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), software supply-chain security, vulnerability management, artifact integrity, and code signing. Working within the Engineering DevSecOps team and closely with the CI/CD Architecture Lead, the Senior DevSecOps Security Engineer will partner with development teams to embed security controls into engineering workflows, strengthen secure development practices, and support the remediation of vulnerabilities identified through automated tooling. The role will also collaborate closely with Telesat Cybersecurity and Compliance teams to translate security policies, standards, and control requirements into practical, automated engineering controls.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Senior Program Manager – Ground System Modem leads end-to-end delivery of the modem within a complex SATCOM ground-system solution. This role is accountable for integrated planning, supplier execution, cross-functional and technical alignment, acceptance, deployment, and operational readiness. Combining strong program leadership with telecommunications/SATCOM knowledge, the Senior Program Manager works across engineering, System Architecture, Product Owners, Integration and Test, program controls, Procurement, Operations, and external suppliers to manage dependencies, risks, commitments, and critical decisions. The role may establish a new program or take ownership of an in-flight delivery, quickly building a fact-based view of status, priorities, critical path, supplier commitments, and recovery needs. Success requires strong supplier and stakeholder leadership, commercial and contractual awareness, and a delivery-focused approach that drives issues and decisions to closure.

jobs.title: Senior Python Test Automation Engineer
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We are seeking a senior Python Automation Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for distributed, event-driven applications. This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on Python-based automation, quality engineering, and team mentorship. You will work closely with software developers, DevOps engineers, and architects to improve software quality, accelerate release cycles, and ensure reliable validation of APIs, user interfaces, and microservices. In addition to hands-on development, you will mentor engineers, coordinate testing activities, and help drive automation best practices across the team.

jobs.title: Senior Spectrum Engineer
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The incumbent is responsible for securing, maintaining, and protecting the spectrum and orbital rights required to support Telesat's GSO and NGSO satellite systems. The role leads complex spectrum engineering, ITU filing and coordination activities; conducts interference and compatibility analyses; supports satellite system design from a spectrum and regulatory perspective; and represents Telesat in technical coordination discussions with satellite operators, administrations, and relevant domestic and international regulatory bodies. The position provides technical and regulatory advice that informs satellite system design, spectrum strategy, and regulatory decisions.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Writer
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Senior Technical Writer is responsible for developing, maintaining, and improving Engineering Design Documentation across the Lightspeed program. This role serves as the central documentation authority for component-level architecture and design knowledge, ensuring that engineering teams have access to accurate, consistent, and maintainable technical documentation. The role supports the development of both High Level Design (HLD) and Detailed Design Description (DDD) documentation for key Engineering Segment components such as On-Board Processor Software Systems, User Terminals (UTs) Systems, LS LS-BB and ACU Systems The successful candidate works closely with System Architects, Software Architects, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), Developers, Integration Teams, and Product Owners to transform existing engineering knowledge into structured, maintainable design documentation. The documentation produced complements existing Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), Interface Control Documents (ICDs), Technical Requirement Documents (TRDs), Architecture Reviews, Confluence content, Implementation repositories Capella (MBSE) content and acts as the authoritative engineering knowledge repository for internal engineering teams.

jobs.title: Spécialiste en ingénierie d’intégration et d’essais / Integration and Test Engineering Specialist
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: Télésat (Nasdaq et TSX : TSAT) est un opérateur mondial de satellites de premier plan qui fournit depuis plus de 50 ans des solutions de communication par satellite fiables et sécurisées à des clients du secteur de la radiodiffusion, des télécommunications, des entreprises et des gouvernements. Forte d'une tradition d'excellence en ingénierie, de fiabilité et de service à la clientèle de premier ordre dans le secteur, Télésat est devenue l'un des opérateurs mondiaux de satellites les plus importants et les plus prospères. jobs.title: Workday Developer
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We are seeking a highly skilled Workday Developer with 3+ years of Finance-focused experience in Workday configuration, security, reporting, custom integrations, APIs, and user support. SQL and API experience are required. Workday HCM/Procurement exposure and Power BI/Databricks interest are a plus. jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description_text: Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries. Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security. With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity. If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! Role Overview The Accounting Manager will work to provide day-to-day leadership of the Accounting team and raise the technical bar. This role exists to give the Accounting team a dedicated leader, to shorten and de-risk the close, and to bring firm-grade technical rigour to judgement areas that currently escalate to the Controller.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Manager
jobs.description_text: Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Accounts Payable Manager to join our Finance team and oversee day-to-day accounts payable operations. This role is responsible for leading a team of AP professionals, ensuring payments are processed accurately and efficiently, maintaining established controls and procedures, and supporting compliance and audit requirements. This position is ideal for a hands-on leader who enjoys developing team members, improving processes, and partnering cross-functionally to support business operations while maintaining appropriate financial controls.

jobs.title: Accounts Receivable Coordinator
jobs.description_text: Role Overview We are looking for an Accounts Receivable Coordinator to join our growing Finance team at Magnet Forensics. In this role, you will help maintain the accuracy and integrity of our global accounts receivable balances by supporting timely customer collections, accurately applying worldwide cash receipts, resolving account discrepancies, and preparing related reconciliations. The successful candidate will be detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working through complex customer account issues. You will collaborate with teams across the organization and communicate directly with customers to support timely resolution while maintaining a positive customer experience. If you enjoy solving problems, improving processes, and contributing to a growing technology company, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Customer Success Architect
jobs.description_text: Role Overview The Customer Success Architect is part of a highly collaborative team of digital forensic, investigative, and technology subject-matter experts. The team partners across Customer Success, Professional Services, Support, Sales, Product Management, and Engineering to guide customers through implementation, adoption, optimization, and expansion while helping them achieve measurable value from Magnet solutions. As a Customer Success Architect, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout the customer lifecycle - from solution evaluation and design through implementation, adoption, and ongoing optimization. You will help customers deploy and scale Magnet solutions within complex environments by combining deep expertise in enterprise networking, security, cloud and hybrid architectures, integrations, investigative workflows, and troubleshooting with a strong understanding of customer goals and business outcomes. Working closely with Customer Success Managers and cross-functional teams, you will reduce technical barriers, accelerate time to value, strengthen adoption, and establish repeatable technical success practices that scale across the customer base. You will also provide technical continuity at key customer transition points to ensure requirements, expectations, and business objectives remain aligned.
